preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 70 and 1 <= M <= 70 and 1 <= K <= 70 for N, M, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, N, M, and K are integers between 1 and 70 inclusive.
The number of test case lines matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == min_max_stones(test_cases[i][0], test_cases[i][1], test_cases[i][2]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line i is the minimum possible value of the maximum number of stones on any cell (excluding start and end) when K paths are chosen optimally.
